ownership: One post-chain O_CREAT|O_EXCL lease records owner PID and birth, exact registration, consumer identity, AC reading, output reservation and phase. Any existing lease refuses new work, including stale or ambiguous ownership; no automatic stale recovery.

Acquire only after original lease release, raw evidence validation and AC confirmation. Heavy stage source/binary/AC/dependency checks run immediately before launch and after waits. Unknown power blocks. Caffeinate and nice 15; no other heavy task during timings.

Output reservations and terminal records are exclusive-create. A consumed score reservation is retained after any failure. No automatic retry, overwrite, test reselection or additional training after test opening.

Consumers retain child PID/birth and waited-exit evidence. Release only own lease after children are proven ended; ambiguous children preserve the lease for operator review. Failed but ended stages retain their actual verdict and logs.
Final source/input/binary drift or unreadability invalidates acceptance, gives ERROR/nonzero and preserves evidence. Never report COMPLETE without expected artifact coverage/hash checks.
